name: Triple Tech Cost
description: Every technology level on the Tech screen costs 3 times its normal price, in tech points: Farming level 2 1,500 -> 4,500, level 3 90,000 -> 270,000; Exploration level 2 10,000 -> 30,000, level 3 160,000 -> 480,000; Science level 2 16,000 -> 48,000, level 3 150,000 -> 450,000; Medicine level 2 20,000 -> 60,000, level 3 65,000 -> 195,000; Engineering level 2 5,000 -> 15,000, level 3 75,000 -> 225,000; Culture level 2 20,000 -> 60,000, level 3 85,000 -> 255,000. The Tech screen shows the tripled price, a purchase is refused (and nothing is spent) with fewer tech points than that, and buying takes exactly that many. Research, tech points from anywhere else, every other tech-point cost (such as clothes) and the patcher's own upgrades are unchanged. **Needs no other patch.** Makes the game super hard.
behavior_changes: Every technology price immediate in the Tech screen's hover label (0x441D80), information box (0x4422F0) and buy handler (0x4437FF), each a price immediate, x 3: the shown price, the buy handler's refusal threshold (cmp / jb: too few tech points shows the game's message and spends nothing) and the amount it takes (sub) are the same tripled number.
explicit_non_changes: Each price is changed in place, same length; no code is added and no executable space is claimed.

Research, tech points from island events and duplicate collectibles, every other tech-point cost (such as 5,000 for clothes) and the patcher's Origins and Story / Cheat upgrades keep their stock numbers.
